'''Joshua Andersen''' (also written '''Joshua Anderson''') was a finalist at the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]]. Andersen qualified through Tatooine Denver from Sandy, Utah.<ref name="pkt">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf 1998 World Championship packet], Decipher / Kendrick Summers (20 November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195330/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> Andersen won the [[1997 Tatooine Regionals (Denver)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="nf97tat">[http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/tatooinequalifier.html The Wild Wild West: Stranger Takes Star Wars CCG Denver Title], Rich Loftus, Decipher NewsFlash (6 June 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970607091955/http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/tatooinequalifier.html Internet Archive]</ref>
